card.fact_statement: The fossil material of Ardetosaurus includes a partial left femur.
card.source_span: The bones referable to MAB011899 comprise cervical vertebrae 13–14, dorsal vertebrae 1–10, several ribs, part of the sacrum, the left ilium, the pubes and ischia, the first five caudal vertebrae, two chevrons, the left coracoid, the partial left femur and fibula, the left tibia.

card.fact_statement: The juvenile Sidersaura specimen consisting of a dorsal centrum is cataloged as MMCh-PV 309.
card.source_span: MMCh-PV 309, belonging to a juvenile individual, consists of a dorsal centrum.
